scope: Dated documented combinations; planned issues do not imply delivery or universal support.

entries.combination: DOCX theme fonts and colors in ordinary formatting
entries.boundary: Stored explicit family/RGB or output fallback is used; theme semantics are not retained.

entries.combination: DOCX theme and conditional table styles
entries.boundary: Direct supported cell appearance is separate from unsupported style resolution.

entries.combination: Opt-in typed DOCX controls in admitted body/cell paragraphs
entries.boundary: Local binding and display have explicit owner, formatting and output-profile limits.

entries.combination: Word-generated glossary category and relationship graphs
entries.boundary: The existing placeholder glossary subset does not admit these editor-generated graphs.

entries.combination: Nested controls, row/cell wrappers and header/footer owners
entries.boundary: These owners and combinations are outside the current typed preservation profile.

entries.combination: Inserting fragments with live fields or into table-cell placeholders
entries.boundary: The existing fragment API accepts an admitted plain body bookmark and rejects source fields.

entries.combination: Rendering a redline of retained history in PDF or SVG
entries.boundary: Existing non-DOCX review output requires explicit decisions and a detached view.

entries.combination: Arabic/Hindi native typography with merged business tables and additional features
entries.boundary: Existing native paragraph/table profiles do not establish all requested combinations.

entries.combination: Roadmap #102 drawing extensions in tagged/archive PDF or native typography
entries.boundary: The new drawing extensions require ordinary managed fixed output.

entries.combination: Mixed paragraph/table report regions with one master-detail level
entries.boundary: Deeper block nesting and ambiguous wrappers remain rejected.

entries.combination: Prepared cross-tab inserted into a named report region
entries.boundary: The existing API appends a bounded cross-tab; region insertion is a later scope.

entries.combination: New chart families, matrix equations and n-ary operators
entries.boundary: The existing chart and equation profiles remain bounded to their admitted graphs.

entries.combination: Named macro-free DOTX/OTT template formats and byte-based detection
entries.boundary: Template identities and automatic format inspection are not current public format support.
Current inspection exposes aggregate pages, fonts and diagnostics, not node rectangles.

entries.combination: Compiled template plan and enforced explicit loss policy
entries.boundary: The proposed contract is design-only; current inspection is not a conversion guarantee.
